**Tier 5** — results — pinned to dataset + policy + engine version · owned by `engine` · `public.run_usage`

**One row is** One capacity event of one run: its reservation when it was dispatched (`dispatch`), what it actually used when it finished (`complete`), or the release of its series storage when the sweep expired them (`expire`). The ledger a month's compute is read from.

## Uniqueness

| Columns | Source | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `run_id` + `kind` | UNIQUE constraint | `run_usage_run_kind_key` |
| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `run_usage_pkey` |

**Natural key:** `run_id` + `kind` — the key this table's grain implies, and the
database ENFORCES it: `run_usage_run_kind_key`. A re-upload of the same row updates
it rather than duplicating it.

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `viewer` |
| Tier transitions audited | **no** — invariant `audit-actor` is not met here yet |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | **none** |

No API role reads or writes it: RLS is on with no policy. Written only by SECURITY DEFINER code — `create_simulation_run` (the reservation, in the same statement as the run row it reserves for), the `simulation_runs_usage_complete` trigger (the actual, once per run) and `simulation_runs_usage_expire` (the release) — and read only through `get_my_capacity` and the super admin's `admin_org_capacity_usage` (the super admin's usage view, `src/pages/admin/AdminUsage.tsx` — an admin page, outside §5.1's lineage). NOT AUDITED: tier 5 is output, append-only by its `(run_id, kind)` key, and each row names the member and the run itself. Compute used is the ledger's, so deleting runs does not hand a month's compute back; storage used is derived from the live runs, so a deleted run frees its bytes whatever deleted it.

> **RLS is on and this table has no policy.** That is deny-all for every role except
> `service_role`, which bypasses RLS. If a page reads this table directly and gets zero
> rows, this is why.
